title: Papertris
summary: A puzzle game inspired by Tetris.

blocks.text: Papertris is an interesting and fun arcade puzzle game in which colored cubes dissolve in all 6 possible directions and you decide where to place your cubes. In addition, there are also power cubes and numerous possible combinations in a classic but modern and lovingly hand-painted game.

items: The Challenge mode is tricky with various tasks where the player has to solve suitable tasks in order to get to the next level, which are more difficult at each level
In the Endless mode, which gets faster and more difficult from level to level, you can score points as long as you can
The 2 player VS mode demands tactical skill in which players can use numerous combos to send each other blocking cubes to block the opponent’s options
Combinations of the cubes in all 6 directions
Icon option for color blind people
